title: AgentWorkConversationalData - Data API
description: Stores conversation data for agent work sessions, such as agent interactions, transfer information, and operational metrics. This object is available in API version 66.0 and later.

AgentChannelRecordingId.description: Identifier for the recording associated with the agent channel conversation. This field is a relationship field.

AgentConnectDateTime.description: Timestamp for when the agent connected to the conversation.

AgentCustomerMergeTime.description: Timestamp when the service rep and customer conversations are merged after consultation.

AgentDisconnectDateTime.description: Timestamp for when the agent disconnected from the conversation.

AgentId.description: ID of an agent or a rep involved in the conversation. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

AgentType.properties: Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
AgentType.description: Type of agent handling the conversation. Possible values are: ExternalBot Human InternalBot

AgentWorkId.description: ID of the AgentWork record associated with the conversational data. This field is a relationship field.

ChannelSessionRecordId.description: Identifier of the channel session for the conversation. This field is a relationship field.

LongestPauseDuration.description: Duration of the longest pause during the conversation, measured in seconds.

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
Name.description: Name of the agent work conversational data record.

NextAgentWorkConvId.description: ID of the next record in a sequence of conversations. This field is a relationship field.

OwnerId.description: ID of the owner of the conversational data record. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

OwnershipEndDateTime.description: Timestamp for when ownership of the conversation ended.

OwnershipStartDateTime.description: Timestamp for when ownership of this conversation started.

PauseCount.description: Total number of times the conversation was paused.

PrevAgentWorkConvId.description: ID of the previous record in a sequence of conversations. This field is a relationship field.

QualityScore.description: Value of the Mean Opinion Score (MOS) that measures voice call quality.

TotalPauseDuration.description: Total duration of all pauses during the conversation, measured in seconds.

TransferType.properties: Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
TransferType.description: Type of transfer for the conversation. Possible values are: Cold Warm

special_access_rules: You must have the Agentforce Contact Center Admin (Salesforce Voice) permission set enabled in your org.
